 physical input, native platforms or hardware FPS.
+
+## Navigation screenshot regression (#751)
+
+The [visual reference guide](tests/navigation-baselines/README.md) owns the eight
+frozen browser screens, fixed fonts/browser/backend, pixel comparison policy,
+intentional visual defect demonstration and explicit independent baseline approval.
+`npm run test:visual` compares all screens; run it twice for determinism and run
+`npm run test:visual:negative` to prove the comparator rejects a real CSS defect.
+The ordinary `test:browser` suite includes these captures. Candidate generation
+never approves a baseline; CI blocks changed references until a human collaborator
+approves the exact manifest digest. Software WebGL does not qualify hardware GPUs.

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+// Read-only gate. Agents must never post the human approval this checks for.
+import {readFile,mkdir,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {sha256,verifyApproval} from './visual-comparison.ts'
+
+const path='tests/navigation-baselines/manifest.json'
+const manifestBytes=await readFile(path),manifest=JSON.parse(manifestBytes.toString()),digest=sha256(manifestBytes)
+for(const [name,expected] of Object.entries(manifest.images)) {
+ if(!/^[a-z-]+\.png$/.test(name))throw Error('Invalid baseline path')
+ if(sha256(await readFile(`tests/navigation-baselines/${name}`))!==expected)throw Error(`Baseline hash mismatch: ${name}`)
+}
+const base=process.env.SALIMON_BASE_SHA
+if(!base||!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(base))throw Error('Expected SALIMON_BASE_SHA (exact PR base)')
+let inherited=false
+try {inherited=execFileSync('git',['show',`${base}:client/${path}`],{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).equals(manifestBytes)}catch{/* Initial baseline needs approval. */}
+const comments:Parameters<typeof verifyApproval>[0]=[]
+if(!inherited) {
+ const pr=process.env.SALIMON_PR_NUMBER,token=process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+ if(!pr||!/^\d+$/.test(pr)||!token)throw Error(`BASELINE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: post human review "Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}" to this PR, then rerun the gate`)
+ for(let page=1;;page++) {
+  const response=await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/mr-exception/salimon/issues/${pr}/comments?per_page=100&page=${page}`,{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,Accept:'application/vnd.github+json'}})
+  if(!response.ok)throw Error(`Cannot read baseline approvals: HTTP ${response.status}`)
+  const batch=await response.json();if(!Array.isArray(batch))throw Error('Invalid approval response')
+  comments.push(...batch);if(batch.length<100)break
+ }
+}
+const approved=inherited||verifyApproval(comments,digest)
+await mkdir('test-results',{recursive:true})
+await writeFile('test-results/baseline-approval.json',JSON.stringify({digest,base,inherited,approved,scope:'Human baseline approval; independent implementation QA remains separate.'},null,2)+'\n')
+if(!approved)throw Error(`BASELINE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: human OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR must post exactly "Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}"; candidates are not approved references`)
+console.log(`Baseline approval PASS (${inherited?'inherited from base':'explicit human review'}): ${digest}`)

+// Test a real CSS defect through the running App and screenshot comparator.
+import {cp,mkdtemp,mkdir,readFile,writeFile,symlink,rm} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {tmpdir} from 'node:os'
+import {join,resolve,basename} from 'node:path'
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto'
+const root=process.cwd(),output=resolve(process.env.SALIMON_VISUAL_NEGATIVE_DIR??'test-results/visual-negative')
+const scratch=await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(),'salimon-visual-negative-'))
+const hash=s=>createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex')
+try {
+ await cp(root,scratch,{recursive:true,filter:path=>!['node_modules','test-results','playwright-report','.git'].includes(basename(path))})
+ await symlink(join(root,'node_modules'),join(scratch,'node_modules'),'dir')
+ // Preserve revision metadata without making the copy a mutable repository.
+ const git=await readFile(join(root,'.revision-for-negative'),'utf8').catch(()=>null)
+ const source=git??spawnSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{cwd:root,encoding:'utf8'}).stdout.trim()
+ await writeFile(join(scratch,'.revision-for-negative'),source)
+ const target=join(scratch,'src/styles.css'),original=await readFile(target,'utf8')
+ const before='[data-vector=velocity]{stroke:#b6f5a2;',after='[data-vector=velocity]{stroke:#ff0000;'
+ if(original.split(before).length!==2)throw Error('Visual mutation must match exactly once')
+ const changed=original.replace(before,after);await writeFile(target,changed)
+ const child=spawnSync(process.execPath,[join(root,'node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js'),'test','--project=navigation-captures'],{cwd:scratch,env:{...process.env,CI:'true',SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES:'',SALIMON_EVIDENCE_DIR:output},encoding:'utf8',timeout:240000,maxBuffer:2e6})
+ await mkdir(output,{recursive:true});await writeFile(join(output,'command.log'),`${child.stdout??''}\n${child.stderr??''}`)
+ const report=JSON.parse(await readFile(join(output,'results.json'),'utf8'))
+ const specs=suite=>[...(suite.specs??[]),...(suite.suites??[]).flatMap(specs)]
+ const results=report.suites.flatMap(specs).flatMap(s=>s.tests??[]).flatMap(t=>t.results??[])
+ const attachments=results[0]?.attachments??[]
+ const summaryAttachment=attachments.find(a=>a.name==='comparison-summary.json')
+ const summary=summaryAttachment?JSON.parse(summaryAttachment.body?Buffer.from(summaryAttachment.body,'base64').toString():await readFile(summaryAttachment.path,'utf8')):null
+ const errors=results.flatMap(r=>r.errors??[]).map(e=>e.message??'').join('\n')
+ const detected=child.status===1&&!child.error&&report.stats.unexpected===1&&results.length===1&&results[0].status==='failed'&&summary?.results.length===8&&summary.results.filter(r=>!r.pass).length===2&&summary.results.filter(r=>!r.pass).every(r=>['heading-velocity','opposite-vectors'].includes(r.id)&&r.changedPixels>100)&&errors.includes('VISUAL_PIXEL_MISMATCH heading-velocity')&&errors.includes('VISUAL_PIXEL_MISMATCH opposite-vectors')
+ await writeFile(join(output,'mutation-summary.json'),JSON.stringify({status:detected?'PASS':'INVALID_DEMONSTRATION',source,file:'src/styles.css',original_sha256:hash(original),mutated_sha256:hash(changed),mutation:{before,after},exit:child.status,comparison:summary},null,2)+'\n')
+ if(!detected)throw Error(`Visual defect did not fail only the intended comparisons: ${output}`)
+ console.log('VIS-1 PASS: red velocity fails two real browser screenshots; six unchanged screens pass; originals/diffs/trace retained')
+} finally {await rm(scratch,{recursive:true,force:true})}

+import {test} from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import {PNG} from 'pngjs'
+import {compareImages,verifyApproval} from './visual-comparison.ts'
+
+test('VIS-1 comparison passes identical images and detects a changed frame with a retained diff',()=>{
+ const a=new PNG({width:128,height:80});a.data.fill(255)
+ const original=PNG.sync.write(a)
+ assert.equal(compareImages(original,original).changedPixels,0)
+ for(let y=20;y<40;y++)for(let x=30;x<70;x++)a.data.set([255,0,0,255],(y*128+x)*4)
+ const result=compareImages(original,PNG.sync.write(a))
+ assert.equal(result.pass,false);assert.equal(result.changedPixels,800)
+ assert.equal(PNG.sync.read(result.diff).width,128)
+ assert.throws(()=>compareImages(original,PNG.sync.write(new PNG({width:1,height:1}))),/VISUAL_DIMENSIONS/)
+ assert.throws(()=>compareImages(original,Buffer.from('invalid PNG')))
+})
+test('VIS-3 approval is exact, digest-bound and requires a human collaborator',()=>{
+ const comment={body:'Approve navigation baselines: abc',user:{type:'User'},author_association:'OWNER'}
+ assert.equal(verifyApproval([comment],'abc'),true)
+ assert.equal(verifyApproval([comment],'changed'),false)
+ assert.equal(verifyApproval([{...comment,user:{type:'Bot'}}],'abc'),false)
+ assert.equal(verifyApproval([{...comment,author_association:'NONE'}],'abc'),false)
+ assert.equal(verifyApproval([{...comment,body:'Looks good abc'}],'abc'),false)
+})
diff --git a/client/scripts/visual-comparison.ts b/client/scripts/visual-comparison.ts
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..953a962
--- /dev/null
+++ b/client/scripts/visual-comparison.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto'
+import {PNG} from 'pngjs'
+import pixelmatch from 'pixelmatch'
+
+// No masks. Reject every pixel beyond the perceptual color threshold, including
+// antialiasing differences. A single changed line cannot hide in a global ratio.
+export const POLICY={threshold:0.1,maxDiffPixels:0,includeAA:true,masks:[]} as const
+export const sha256=(data:Buffer|string)=>createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')
+export function compareImages(expected:Buffer,actual:Buffer) {
+ const a=PNG.sync.read(expected),b=PNG.sync.read(actual)
+ if(a.width!==b.width||a.height!==b.height)throw Error(`VISUAL_DIMENSIONS: ${a.width}x${a.height} vs ${b.width}x${b.height}`)
+ const diff=new PNG({width:a.width,height:a.height})
+ const changedPixels=pixelmatch(a.data,b.data,diff.data,a.width,a.height,{threshold:POLICY.threshold,includeAA:POLICY.includeAA})
+ let rawChangedPixels=0
+ for(let i=0;i<a.data.length;i+=4)if(!a.data.subarray(i,i+4).equals(b.data.subarray(i,i+4)))rawChangedPixels++
+ return {pass:changedPixels<=POLICY.maxDiffPixels,changedPixels,rawChangedPixels,totalPixels:a.width*a.height,diff:PNG.sync.write(diff)}
+}
+export function verifyApproval(comments:{body?:string|null;user?:{type?:string}|null;author_association?:string}[],digest:string) {
+ return comments.some(c=>c.body?.trim()===`Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}`&&c.user?.type==='User'&&['OWNER','MEMBER','COLLABORATOR'].includes(c.author_association??''))
+}

+# Navigation visual references (#751)
+
+These eight initial images are **candidates pending explicit human approval**.
+Pixel equality is separate from accepting a reference as correct. The CI approval
+gate must pass before QA acceptance. No implementation agent may post approval.
+
+| Original | Observable case |
+| --- | --- |
+| [Empty scanner](empty-scanner.png) | Seeded universe before the first scan, no catalog leak |
+| [Visible contacts](visible-contacts.png) | Four distinct faceted bodies, fixed front camera |
+| [Panning](panned-contacts.png) | Real D-key camera movement, bodies retained |
+| [Selected body](selected-body.png) | Moon picker selection and selection geometry |
+| [Zoom out](zoom-out.png) | Fixed zoom 0.1, linear world projection |
+| [Zoom in](zoom-in.png) | Fixed zoom 1, readable proxies |
+| [Heading/velocity](heading-velocity.png) | Yellow heading right, green dashed velocity up |
+| [Opposite vectors](opposite-vectors.png) | Heading and velocity reach opposite edges |
+
+Full 1280×800 viewport images include the actual WebGL canvas, DOM vector overlay
+and sidebar layout. No masks, cropping, dynamic substitutions or CSS geometry
+changes are applied. Vendored, licensed DejaVu fonts supply the fixture's `Inter`
+family to avoid host fallback changes. Ordinary production and browser tests still
+exercise system fonts; this fixture CSS does not ship in the production entry.
+
+## Compare and retain evidence
+
+```sh
+npm ci
+npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+npm run build
+npm run test:visual
+SALIMON_EVIDENCE_DIR=test-results/visual-repeat npm run test:visual
+npm run test:visual:negative
+```
+
+Use the lockfile Chromium on Linux x64; do not set `CHROMIUM_PATH` for reference
+qualification. Environment drift (browser/Playwright/platform/architecture/font
+hashes/renderer) fails explicitly. Host distro/version is recorded in the issue
+report/CI runner rather than asserting Debian and Ubuntu are the same OS.
+Seed 750, fixture front camera, fixed zooms, DPR 1, en-US/UTC, dark scheme and
+paused RAF/performance clock are recorded in `manifest.json` and observations.
+The capture waits for fonts and completed production frames. Screenshot capture
+never fast-forwards animations. Traces are retained even on success.
+
+`comparisons/` under each test output contains actual, expected, diff and original
+state/metadata JSON for every case. The summary records changed and raw changed
+pixels and both hashes. Pixelmatch uses color threshold 0.1, includes antialiasing,
+and permits **zero** pixels over threshold. No mask is justified by these frozen
+scenes. CI uploads SHA-named originals/diffs/metadata/traces for 14 days; essential
+issue evidence is retained beside the delivery report. A page error, environment
+change, absent contacts, wrong selection or corrupted/missing reference fails.
+
+The negative driver changes the actual velocity CSS to red in a disposable copy.
+Only the two velocity-visible frames must fail, with >100 changed pixels each;
+the other six must pass. Timeout, startup error or unrelated visual failures do
+not count as detecting the defect. It never edits checkout references.
+
+## Propose and independently approve a baseline
+
+1. First investigate the unexpected difference. Never update references merely
+   because a check fails. Browser/OS upgrades are separate deliberate changes;
+   retain old and new originals, environment versions, metrics and upgrade reason.
+2. Generate *candidates* outside the tracked reference directory:
+   `SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES=/tmp/navigation-candidates npm run test:visual`.
+   Candidate generation is forbidden in CI. `--update-snapshots` has no effect on
+   this custom comparator and cannot update these files.
+3. Copy reviewed candidates and their complete `manifest.json` into this directory
+   in a dedicated reviewable change. Run normal comparisons twice and the negative
+   driver; preserve the previous originals in git and expected/diff artifacts.
+4. A human repository OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR independently reviews every image,
+   environment/threshold change, functional tests and diff. Post exactly this on
+   the delivering PR, substituting the SHA-256 of the **manifest bytes**:
+   `Approve navigation baselines: <sha256>`.
+   Agents must never write this comment, impersonate the reviewer or count their
+   own image judgment as approval. The human can use the same GitHub account that
+   hosts an agent-authored PR; independence is from the implementing agent.
+5. Rerun the failed approval step/job. It validates image hashes and accepts only
+   that exact digest from a human collaborator (Bot/unaffiliated accounts fail).
+   Any changed manifest invalidates the approval. A byte-identical manifest
+   inherited from the PR base needs no repeat approval. Baseline approval does
+   not replace independent implementation QA or authorize merging.
+
+GitHub branch protection must require the Navigation client check for enforcement
+at merge; this issue does not change repository administration settings. A repo
+maintainer can always alter workflow policy; ordinary implementation agents cannot
+waive it. Review comments are audit evidence, not a cryptographic proof of who
+operated an account. Required human decisions stay visible as BLOCKED until made.
+
+Software SwiftShader browser coverage does not qualify physical input, discrete
+GPUs, Metal, Windows rendering, native platforms, hardware FPS or subjective art.
+Historical native mesh regression #228 is a distinct renderer/asset contract.

+import {test,expect} from '@playwright/test'
+import {readFile,writeFile,mkdir} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {join} from 'node:path'
+import {boot,snapshot,json,EPOCH} from './deterministic'
+import {POLICY,sha256,compareImages} from '../scripts/visual-comparison.ts'
+
+const directory='tests/navigation-baselines'
+const candidate=process.env.SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES||undefined
+if(candidate&&process.env.CI)throw Error('Candidate generation is forbidden in CI')
+const cases=[
+ {id:'empty-scanner',scenario:'seeded-empty',vector:'zero'},
+ {id:'visible-contacts'},
+ {id:'panned-contacts',pan:true},
+ {id:'selected-body',selected:true},
+ {id:'zoom-out',zoom:.1},
+ {id:'zoom-in',zoom:1},
+ {id:'heading-velocity',vector:'different'},
+ {id:'opposite-vectors',vector:'opposite'}
+] as const
+// One ordered session preserves a single manifest and complete comparison summary.
+test('VIS-1/2 eight navigation screens match reference pixels',async({page,browser},info)=>{
+ const errors:string[]=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message))
+ const fonts=await Promise.all(['DejaVuSans.ttf','DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf','fonts.css'].map(async f=>[f,sha256(await readFile(`tests/assets/${f}`))]))
+ const source=(await readFile('.revision-for-negative','utf8').catch(()=>null))??execFileSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim()
+ const environment={platform:process.platform,arch:process.arch,browser:browser.version(),playwright:JSON.parse(await readFile('node_modules/@playwright/test/package.json','utf8')).version,viewport:{width:1280,height:800},dpr:1,locale:'en-US',timezone:'UTC',colorScheme:'dark',fontHashes:Object.fromEntries(fonts),seed:750,epoch:EPOCH,policy:POLICY}
+ const manifest=candidate?null:JSON.parse(await readFile(`${directory}/manifest.json`,'utf8'))
+ const results:Record<string,unknown>[]=[],images:Record<string,string>={}
+ const output=candidate??info.outputPath('comparisons')
+ await mkdir(output,{recursive:true})
+ // Drift is a failure, never an instruction to regenerate references.
+ if(manifest)expect(environment,'VISUAL_ENVIRONMENT_DRIFT: propose separately reviewed candidates').toEqual(manifest.environment)
+ for(const fixture of cases) {
+  const c:{id:string;scenario?:string;vector?:string;pan?:boolean;selected?:boolean;zoom?:number}=fixture
+  await boot(page,`scenario=${c.scenario??'seeded'}&seed=750&view=front&vector=${c.vector??'zero'}&zoom=${c.zoom??.5}`)
+  await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready)
+  if(c.selected)await page.getByLabel('Scanned contacts (4)',{exact:true}).selectOption('moon')
+  if(c.pan){await page.keyboard.down('d');await page.clock.runFor(160);await page.keyboard.up('d')}
+  // Deterministic completed RAF; no screenshot animation fast-forward or polling
+  // against mutating frames. Font loading completes before this last frame.
+  await page.clock.runFor(32)
+  await page.mouse.move(1279,799)
+  const state=await snapshot(page)
+  expect(state.scene.renderer,'VISUAL_BACKEND').toContain('SwiftShader')
+  if(manifest)expect(state.scene.renderer,'VISUAL_RENDERER_DRIFT').toBe(manifest.renderer)
+  if(c.scenario==='seeded-empty')expect(state.navigation.pulse).toBe(0)
+  else expect(state.scene.objects.filter(o=>o.name.startsWith('nav-body:')).length,'VISUAL_NONVACUOUS_CONTACTS').toBeGreaterThan(0)
+  if(c.selected)expect(state.navigation.selected).toBe('moon')
+  const actual=await page.screenshot({caret:'hide'})
+  const name=`${c.id}.png`;images[name]=sha256(actual)
+  await writeFile(join(output,name),actual)
+  await writeFile(join(output,`${c.id}.json`),json({source,environment,fixture,state,errors}))
+  await info.attach(name,{body:actual,contentType:'image/png'})
+  if(candidate){results.push({id:c.id,status:'CANDIDATE',sha256:sha256(actual)});continue}
+  const original=await readFile(join(directory,name))
+  expect(sha256(original),'BASELINE_HASH_MISMATCH').toBe(manifest.images[name])
+  const comparison=compareImages(original,actual)
+  await writeFile(join(output,`${c.id}-expected.png`),original)
+  await writeFile(join(output,`${c.id}-diff.png`),comparison.diff)
+  await info.attach(`${c.id}-diff.png`,{body:comparison.diff,contentType:'image/png'})
+  const {diff:_,...measurement}=comparison
+  results.push({id:c.id,...measurement,expected:sha256(original),actual:sha256(actual)})
+ }
+ expect(errors,'VISUAL_PAGE_ERRORS').toEqual([])
+ if(candidate) {
+  const renderer=(await snapshot(page)).scene.renderer
+  await writeFile(join(output,'manifest.json'),json({schema:1,environment,renderer,images})+'\n')
+ }
+ await writeFile(join(output,'summary.json'),json({source,candidate:!!candidate,results})+'\n')
+ await info.attach('comparison-summary.json',{body:json({source,candidate:!!candidate,results}),contentType:'application/json'})
+ // Soft per-frame failures let QA inspect every unexpected screen in one run.
+ for(const r of results)if(!candidate)expect.soft(r.pass,`VISUAL_PIXEL_MISMATCH ${r.id}: ${r.changedPixels} changed pixels`).toBe(true)
+})

+# #751 — navigation browser screenshot regression
+
+Implemented eight frozen full-viewport screenshot comparisons over the production
+App and real Chromium/SwiftShader canvas, with pinned fixture fonts, strict pixel
+policy, durable diagnostics and a real CSS-regression demonstration. **QA pending:
+initial image references are candidates until explicit independent human baseline
+approval.** Required current-head CI and final independent review remain pending
+at report creation. No baseline has been silently approved or regenerated.
+
+Branch `issue-751-navigation-visual-baselines` extends `main` at
+`b0318abf9c9e1e71a349ff1948e074efb04092c7`; no active PR stack existed.
+Current tested source: `46d691231548a6fde59ba056a8f9c125dc693a4e`.
+Final publication head/base, remote CI and independent verdict are bound in the
+PR conversation. #750's merged harness is reused. #224/#228 cover the historical
+native renderer and are not duplicated by browser layout captures.
+
+## Acceptance matrix
+
+| Criterion / category | Required evidence and actual result |
+| --- | --- |
+| VIS-1 / AC1 detection | PASS for executable checks: eight frames pass two runs with **0 changed and 0 raw changed pixels** each. Actual velocity CSS changed from green to red in a disposable App: heading/velocity frame fails at **520 pixels**, opposite vectors at **630 pixels**; six unchanged controls pass exactly. Human acceptance of reference correctness is UNVERIFIED/pending. |
+| VIS-2 / AC2 current evidence | PASS locally: exact committed-source repeat and mutation summaries, all state/environment observations, originals, diffs, success/failure traces and results retained through [index](evidence-index.json). CI publishes the same at its actual head/merge SHA; remote result remains pending. |
+| VIS-3 / AC3 limits and approval | Hardware gaps labeled UNVERIFIED. Changed baseline manifest/image integrity and exact human collaborator approval gate implemented and tested. Actual initial manifest approval BLOCKED until a human independently approves the concrete images. |
+| Unit/integration — mandatory | PASS: 30 domain/comparison/approval assertions; existing production runtime composition, malformed PNG/dimension rejection, exact digest, human role and Bot exclusion. |
+| Build/typecheck — mandatory | PASS: production build and all source/test/visual/approval scripts typecheck. |
+| E2E/visual — mandatory | PASS locally: 24 full browser routes, second eight-screen comparison, real CSS mutation, existing two navigation mutation scenarios. Required current-head CI still pending. |
+| Manual/hardware | No physical input/device execution required for browser harness delivery. Discrete GPUs, Metal, native/Windows rendering, hardware FPS, mobile/touch and subjective art qualification remain UNVERIFIED. Human baseline decision is separately required and is not hardware testing. |
+
+## Changes and ownership
+
+- `client/tests/navigation-captures.spec.ts` runs empty scanner, four visible
+  contacts, real D-key pan, selected moon, zoom 0.1/1, differing and opposite
+  heading/velocity states. It freezes #750's seeded clock/camera and observes
+  completed production frames without authoritative browser writes. Full canvas,
+  SVG vectors and sidebar are captured; no masks or cropping.
+- Vendored licensed DejaVu regular/bold fonts make the fixture's existing Inter
+  family deterministic. Production entry and normal production/system-font routes
+  remain isolated. Fonts, browser, Playwright, platform/architecture, backend,
+  viewport/DPR, locale, seed, epoch and policy are versioned/hashed.
+- `scripts/visual-comparison.ts` uses Pixelmatch color threshold 0.1, includes
+  antialiasing, and permits zero over-threshold pixels. It retains raw mismatch
+  counts, expected/actual/diff PNGs and hashes. Unexpected environment or renderer
+  drift fails; candidate generation is explicit, separate and forbidden in CI.
+- `negative-visual.mjs` mutates actual CSS in a disposable copy. It requires both
+  intended failures plus six unchanged controls; startup errors/timeouts/unrelated
+  failures are invalid demonstrations. Originals and traces remain available.
+- `baseline-approval.ts` validates image hashes and requires an exact manifest
+  digest approval comment from a human repository collaborator for changed
+  references; unchanged base references inherit approval. Agents must not post
+  that approval. Baseline approval remains separate from implementation QA.
+- Navigation CI repeats comparison, proves the CSS defect, gates approval and
+  uploads revision-named raw artifacts (14 days). Checkout fetches merge parents,
+  rather than all historical objects. Token permissions are read-only.
+
+The [reference guide](../../client/tests/navigation-baselines/README.md), client
+guide, validation and maintenance map own capture, drift, proposal/approval,
+threshold and retention procedures. There is no production gameplay change.
+

+intentional visual defect demonstration and explicit independent baseline approval.

+`npm run test:visual:negative` to prove the comparator rejects a real CSS defect.

+approves the exact manifest digest. Software WebGL does not qualify hardware GPUs.

index 0000000..7ed225b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/client/scripts/baseline-approval.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+// Read-only gate. Agents must never post the human approval this checks for.
+import {readFile,mkdir,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {sha256,verifyApproval} from './visual-comparison.ts'
+
+const path='tests/navigation-baselines/manifest.json'
+const manifestBytes=await readFile(path),manifest=JSON.parse(manifestBytes.toString()),digest=sha256(manifestBytes)
+for(const [name,expected] of Object.entries(manifest.images)) {
+ if(!/^[a-z-]+\.png$/.test(name))throw Error('Invalid baseline path')
+ if(sha256(await readFile(`tests/navigation-baselines/${name}`))!==expected)throw Error(`Baseline hash mismatch: ${name}`)
+}
+const base=process.env.SALIMON_BASE_SHA
+if(!base||!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(base))throw Error('Expected SALIMON_BASE_SHA (exact PR base)')
+let inherited=false
+try {inherited=execFileSync('git',['show',`${base}:client/${path}`],{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).equals(manifestBytes)}catch{/* Initial baseline needs approval. */}
+const comments:Parameters<typeof verifyApproval>[0]=[]
+if(!inherited) {
+ const pr=process.env.SALIMON_PR_NUMBER,token=process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+ if(!pr||!/^\d+$/.test(pr)||!token)throw Error(`BASELINE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: post human review "Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}" to this PR, then rerun the gate`)
+ for(let page=1;;page++) {
+  const response=await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/mr-exception/salimon/issues/${pr}/comments?per_page=100&page=${page}`,{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,Accept:'application/vnd.github+json'}})
+  if(!response.ok)throw Error(`Cannot read baseline approvals: HTTP ${response.status}`)
+  const batch=await response.json();if(!Array.isArray(batch))throw Error('Invalid approval response')
+  comments.push(...batch);if(batch.length<100)break
+ }
+}
+const approved=inherited||verifyApproval(comments,digest)
+await mkdir('test-results',{recursive:true})
+await writeFile('test-results/baseline-approval.json',JSON.stringify({digest,base,inherited,approved,scope:'Human baseline approval; independent implementation QA remains separate.'},null,2)+'\n')
+if(!approved)throw Error(`BASELINE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: human OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR must post exactly "Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}"; candidates are not approved references`)
+console.log(`Baseline approval PASS (${inherited?'inherited from base':'explicit human review'}): ${digest}`)

+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto'
+import {PNG} from 'pngjs'
+import pixelmatch from 'pixelmatch'
+
+// No masks. Reject every pixel beyond the perceptual color threshold, including
+// antialiasing differences. A single changed line cannot hide in a global ratio.
+export const POLICY={threshold:0.1,maxDiffPixels:0,includeAA:true,masks:[]} as const
+export const sha256=(data:Buffer|string)=>createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')
+export function compareImages(expected:Buffer,actual:Buffer) {
+ const a=PNG.sync.read(expected),b=PNG.sync.read(actual)
+ if(a.width!==b.width||a.height!==b.height)throw Error(`VISUAL_DIMENSIONS: ${a.width}x${a.height} vs ${b.width}x${b.height}`)
+ const diff=new PNG({width:a.width,height:a.height})
+ const changedPixels=pixelmatch(a.data,b.data,diff.data,a.width,a.height,{threshold:POLICY.threshold,includeAA:POLICY.includeAA})
+ let rawChangedPixels=0
+ for(let i=0;i<a.data.length;i+=4)if(!a.data.subarray(i,i+4).equals(b.data.subarray(i,i+4)))rawChangedPixels++
+ return {pass:changedPixels<=POLICY.maxDiffPixels,changedPixels,rawChangedPixels,totalPixels:a.width*a.height,diff:PNG.sync.write(diff)}
+}
+export function verifyApproval(comments:{body?:string|null;user?:{type?:string}|null;author_association?:string}[],digest:string) {
+ return comments.some(c=>c.body?.trim()===`Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}`&&c.user?.type==='User'&&['OWNER','MEMBER','COLLABORATOR'].includes(c.author_association??''))
+}

+# Navigation visual references (#751)
+
+These eight initial images are **candidates pending explicit human approval**.
+Pixel equality is separate from accepting a reference as correct. The CI approval
+gate must pass before QA acceptance. No implementation agent may post approval.
+
+| Original | Observable case |
+| --- | --- |
+| [Empty scanner](empty-scanner.png) | Seeded universe before the first scan, no catalog leak |
+| [Visible contacts](visible-contacts.png) | Four distinct faceted bodies, fixed front camera |
+| [Panning](panned-contacts.png) | Real D-key camera movement, bodies retained |
+| [Selected body](selected-body.png) | Moon picker selection and selection geometry |
+| [Zoom out](zoom-out.png) | Fixed zoom 0.1, linear world projection |
+| [Zoom in](zoom-in.png) | Fixed zoom 1, readable proxies |
+| [Heading/velocity](heading-velocity.png) | Yellow heading right, green dashed velocity up |
+| [Opposite vectors](opposite-vectors.png) | Heading and velocity reach opposite edges |
+
+Full 1280×800 viewport images include the actual WebGL canvas, DOM vector overlay
+and sidebar layout. No masks, cropping, dynamic substitutions or CSS geometry
+changes are applied. Vendored, licensed DejaVu fonts supply the fixture's `Inter`
+family to avoid host fallback changes. Ordinary production and browser tests still
+exercise system fonts; this fixture CSS does not ship in the production entry.
+
+## Compare and retain evidence
+
+```sh
+npm ci
+npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+npm run build
+npm run test:visual
+SALIMON_EVIDENCE_DIR=test-results/visual-repeat npm run test:visual
+npm run test:visual:negative
+```
+
+Use the lockfile Chromium on Linux x64; do not set `CHROMIUM_PATH` for reference
+qualification. Environment drift (browser/Playwright/platform/architecture/font
+hashes/renderer) fails explicitly. Host distro/version is recorded in the issue
+report/CI runner rather than asserting Debian and Ubuntu are the same OS.
+Seed 750, fixture front camera, fixed zooms, DPR 1, en-US/UTC, dark scheme and
+paused RAF/performance clock are recorded in `manifest.json` and observations.
+The capture waits for fonts and completed production frames. Screenshot capture
+never fast-forwards animations. Traces are retained even on success.
+
+`comparisons/` under each test output contains actual, expected, diff and original
+state/metadata JSON for every case. The summary records changed and raw changed
+pixels and both hashes. Pixelmatch uses color threshold 0.1, includes antialiasing,
+and permits **zero** pixels over threshold. No mask is justified by these frozen
+scenes. CI uploads SHA-named originals/diffs/metadata/traces for 14 days; essential
+issue evidence is retained beside the delivery report. A page error, environment
+change, absent contacts, wrong selection or corrupted/missing reference fails.
+
+The negative driver changes the actual velocity CSS to red in a disposable copy.
+Only the two velocity-visible frames must fail, with >100 changed pixels each;
+the other six must pass. Timeout, startup error or unrelated visual failures do
+not count as detecting the defect. It never edits checkout references.
+
+## Propose and independently approve a baseline
+
+1. First investigate the unexpected difference. Never update references merely
+   because a check fails. Browser/OS upgrades are separate deliberate changes;
+   retain old and new originals, environment versions, metrics and upgrade reason.
+2. Generate *candidates* outside the tracked reference directory:
+   `SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES=/tmp/navigation-candidates npm run test:visual`.
+   Candidate generation is forbidden in CI. `--update-snapshots` has no effect on
+   this custom comparator and cannot update these files.
+3. Copy reviewed candidates and their complete `manifest.json` into this directory
+   in a dedicated reviewable change. Run normal comparisons twice and the negative
+   driver; preserve the previous originals in git and expected/diff artifacts.
+4. A human repository OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR independently reviews every image,
+   environment/threshold change, functional tests and diff. Post exactly this on
+   the delivering PR, substituting the SHA-256 of the **manifest bytes**:
+   `Approve navigation baselines: <sha256>`.
+   Agents must never write this comment, impersonate the reviewer or count their
+   own image judgment as approval. The human can use the same GitHub account that
+   hosts an agent-authored PR; independence is from the implementing agent.
+5. Rerun the failed approval step/job. It validates image hashes and accepts only
+   that exact digest from a human collaborator (Bot/unaffiliated accounts fail).
+   Any changed manifest invalidates the approval. A byte-identical manifest
+   inherited from the PR base needs no repeat approval. Baseline approval does
+   not replace independent implementation QA or authorize merging.
+
+GitHub branch protection must require the Navigation client check for enforcement
+at merge; this issue does not change repository administration settings. A repo
+maintainer can always alter workflow policy; ordinary implementation agents cannot
+waive it. Review comments are audit evidence, not a cryptographic proof of who
+operated an account. Required human decisions stay visible as BLOCKED until made.
+
+Software SwiftShader browser coverage does not qualify physical input, discrete
+GPUs, Metal, Windows rendering, native platforms, hardware FPS or subjective art.
+Historical native mesh regression #228 is a distinct renderer/asset contract.

+ {id:'empty-scanner',scenario:'seeded-empty',vector:'zero'},
+ {id:'visible-contacts'},
+ {id:'panned-contacts',pan:true},
+ {id:'selected-body',selected:true},
+ {id:'zoom-out',zoom:.1},
+ {id:'zoom-in',zoom:1},
+ {id:'heading-velocity',vector:'different'},
+ {id:'opposite-vectors',vector:'opposite'}

+// One ordered session preserves a single manifest and complete comparison summary.
+test('VIS-1/2 eight navigation screens match reference pixels',async({page,browser},info)=>{
+ const errors:string[]=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message))
+ const fonts=await Promise.all(['DejaVuSans.ttf','DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf','fonts.css'].map(async f=>[f,sha256(await readFile(`tests/assets/${f}`))]))
+ const source=(await readFile('.revision-for-negative','utf8').catch(()=>null))??execFileSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim()
+ const environment={platform:process.platform,arch:process.arch,browser:browser.version(),playwright:JSON.parse(await readFile('node_modules/@playwright/test/package.json','utf8')).version,viewport:{width:1280,height:800},dpr:1,locale:'en-US',timezone:'UTC',colorScheme:'dark',fontHashes:Object.fromEntries(fonts),seed:750,epoch:EPOCH,policy:POLICY}
+ const manifest=candidate?null:JSON.parse(await readFile(`${directory}/manifest.json`,'utf8'))
+ const results:Record<string,unknown>[]=[],images:Record<string,string>={}
+ const output=candidate??info.outputPath('comparisons')
+ await mkdir(output,{recursive:true})
+ // Drift is a failure, never an instruction to regenerate references.
+ if(manifest)expect(environment,'VISUAL_ENVIRONMENT_DRIFT: propose separately reviewed candidates').toEqual(manifest.environment)
+ for(const fixture of cases) {
+  const c:{id:string;scenario?:string;vector?:string;pan?:boolean;selected?:boolean;zoom?:number}=fixture
+  await boot(page,`scenario=${c.scenario??'seeded'}&seed=750&view=front&vector=${c.vector??'zero'}&zoom=${c.zoom??.5}`)
+  await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready)
+  if(c.selected)await page.getByLabel('Scanned contacts (4)',{exact:true}).selectOption('moon')
+  if(c.pan){await page.keyboard.down('d');await page.clock.runFor(160);await page.keyboard.up('d')}
+  // Deterministic completed RAF; no screenshot animation fast-forward or polling
+  // against mutating frames. Font loading completes before this last frame.
+  await page.clock.runFor(32)
+  await page.mouse.move(1279,799)
+  const state=await snapshot(page)
+  expect(state.scene.renderer,'VISUAL_BACKEND').toContain('SwiftShader')
+  if(manifest)expect(state.scene.renderer,'VISUAL_RENDERER_DRIFT').toBe(manifest.renderer)
+  if(c.scenario==='seeded-empty')expect(state.navigation.pulse).toBe(0)
+  else expect(state.scene.objects.filter(o=>o.name.startsWith('nav-body:')).length,'VISUAL_NONVACUOUS_CONTACTS').toBeGreaterThan(0)
+  if(c.selected)expect(state.navigation.selected).toBe('moon')
+  const actual=await page.screenshot({caret:'hide'})
+  const name=`${c.id}.png`;images[name]=sha256(actual)
+  await writeFile(join(output,name),actual)
+  await writeFile(join(output,`${c.id}.json`),json({source,environment,fixture,state,errors}))
+  await info.attach(name,{body:actual,contentType:'image/png'})
+  if(candidate){results.push({id:c.id,status:'CANDIDATE',sha256:sha256(actual)});continue}
+  const original=await readFile(join(directory,name))
+  expect(sha256(original),'BASELINE_HASH_MISMATCH').toBe(manifest.images[name])
+  const comparison=compareImages(original,actual)
+  await writeFile(join(output,`${c.id}-expected.png`),original)
+  await writeFile(join(output,`${c.id}-diff.png`),comparison.diff)
+  await info.attach(`${c.id}-diff.png`,{body:comparison.diff,contentType:'image/png'})
+  const {diff:_,...measurement}=comparison
+  results.push({id:c.id,...measurement,expected:sha256(original),actual:sha256(actual)})
+ }
+ expect(errors,'VISUAL_PAGE_ERRORS').toEqual([])
+ if(candidate) {
+  const renderer=(await snapshot(page)).scene.renderer
+  await writeFile(join(output,'manifest.json'),json({schema:1,environment,renderer,images})+'\n')
+ }
+ await writeFile(join(output,'summary.json'),json({source,candidate:!!candidate,results})+'\n')
+ await info.attach('comparison-summary.json',{body:json({source,candidate:!!candidate,results}),contentType:'application/json'})
+ // Soft per-frame failures let QA inspect every unexpected screen in one run.
+ for(const r of results)if(!candidate)expect.soft(r.pass,`VISUAL_PIXEL_MISMATCH ${r.id}: ${r.changedPixels} changed pixels`).toBe(true)
+})

+# #751 — navigation browser screenshot regression
+
+Implemented eight frozen full-viewport screenshot comparisons over the production
+App and real Chromium/SwiftShader canvas, with pinned fixture fonts, strict pixel
+policy, durable diagnostics and a real CSS-regression demonstration. **QA pending:
+initial image references are candidates until explicit independent human baseline
+approval.** Required current-head CI and final independent review remain pending
+at report creation. No baseline has been silently approved or regenerated.
+
+Branch `issue-751-navigation-visual-baselines` extends `main` at
+`b0318abf9c9e1e71a349ff1948e074efb04092c7`; no active PR stack existed.
+Current tested source: `46d691231548a6fde59ba056a8f9c125dc693a4e`.
+Final publication head/base, remote CI and independent verdict are bound in the
+PR conversation. #750's merged harness is reused. #224/#228 cover the historical
+native renderer and are not duplicated by browser layout captures.
+
+## Acceptance matrix
+
+| Criterion / category | Required evidence and actual result |
+| --- | --- |
+| VIS-1 / AC1 detection | PASS for executable checks: eight frames pass two runs with **0 changed and 0 raw changed pixels** each. Actual velocity CSS changed from green to red in a disposable App: heading/velocity frame fails at **520 pixels**, opposite vectors at **630 pixels**; six unchanged controls pass exactly. Human acceptance of reference correctness is UNVERIFIED/pending. |
+| VIS-2 / AC2 current evidence | PASS locally: exact committed-source repeat and mutation summaries, all state/environment observations, originals, diffs, success/failure traces and results retained through [index](evidence-index.json). CI publishes the same at its actual head/merge SHA; remote result remains pending. |
+| VIS-3 / AC3 limits and approval | Hardware gaps labeled UNVERIFIED. Changed baseline manifest/image integrity and exact human collaborator approval gate implemented and tested. Actual initial manifest approval BLOCKED until a human independently approves the concrete images. |
+| Unit/integration — mandatory | PASS: 30 domain/comparison/approval assertions; existing production runtime composition, malformed PNG/dimension rejection, exact digest, human role and Bot exclusion. |
+| Build/typecheck — mandatory | PASS: production build and all source/test/visual/approval scripts typecheck. |
+| E2E/visual — mandatory | PASS locally: 24 full browser routes, second eight-screen comparison, real CSS mutation, existing two navigation mutation scenarios. Required current-head CI still pending. |
+| Manual/hardware | No physical input/device execution required for browser harness delivery. Discrete GPUs, Metal, native/Windows rendering, hardware FPS, mobile/touch and subjective art qualification remain UNVERIFIED. Human baseline decision is separately required and is not hardware testing. |
+
+## Changes and ownership
+
+- `client/tests/navigation-captures.spec.ts` runs empty scanner, four visible
+  contacts, real D-key pan, selected moon, zoom 0.1/1, differing and opposite
+  heading/velocity states. It freezes #750's seeded clock/camera and observes
+  completed production frames without authoritative browser writes. Full canvas,
+  SVG vectors and sidebar are captured; no masks or cropping.
+- Vendored licensed DejaVu regular/bold fonts make the fixture's existing Inter
+  family deterministic. Production entry and normal production/system-font routes
+  remain isolated. Fonts, browser, Playwright, platform/architecture, backend,
+  viewport/DPR, locale, seed, epoch and policy are versioned/hashed.
+- `scripts/visual-comparison.ts` uses Pixelmatch color threshold 0.1, includes
+  antialiasing, and permits zero over-threshold pixels. It retains raw mismatch
+  counts, expected/actual/diff PNGs and hashes. Unexpected environment or renderer
+  drift fails; candidate generation is explicit, separate and forbidden in CI.
+- `negative-visual.mjs` mutates actual CSS in a disposable copy. It requires both
+  intended failures plus six unchanged controls; startup errors/timeouts/unrelated
+  failures are invalid demonstrations. Originals and traces remain available.
+- `baseline-approval.ts` validates image hashes and requires an exact manifest
+  digest approval comment from a human repository collaborator for changed
+  references; unchanged base references inherit approval. Agents must not post
+  that approval. Baseline approval remains separate from implementation QA.
+- Navigation CI repeats comparison, proves the CSS defect, gates approval and
+  uploads revision-named raw artifacts (14 days). Checkout fetches merge parents,
+  rather than all historical objects. Token permissions are read-only.

+The [reference guide](../../client/tests/navigation-baselines/README.md), client

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+// Read-only gate. Agents must never post the human approval this checks for.
+import {readFile,mkdir,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {sha256,verifyApproval} from './visual-comparison.ts'
+
+const path='tests/navigation-baselines/manifest.json'
+const manifestBytes=await readFile(path),manifest=JSON.parse(manifestBytes.toString()),digest=sha256(manifestBytes)
+for(const [name,expected] of Object.entries(manifest.images)) {
+ if(!/^[a-z-]+\.png$/.test(name))throw Error('Invalid baseline path')
+ if(sha256(await readFile(`tests/navigation-baselines/${name}`))!==expected)throw Error(`Baseline hash mismatch: ${name}`)
+}
+const base=process.env.SALIMON_BASE_SHA
+if(!base||!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(base))throw Error('Expected SALIMON_BASE_SHA (exact PR base)')
+let inherited=false
+try {inherited=execFileSync('git',['show',`${base}:client/${path}`],{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).equals(manifestBytes)}catch{/* Initial baseline needs approval. */}
+const comments:Parameters<typeof verifyApproval>[0]=[]
+if(!inherited) {
+ const pr=process.env.SALIMON_PR_NUMBER,token=process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+ if(!pr||!/^\d+$/.test(pr)||!token)throw Error(`BASELINE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: post human review "Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}" to this PR, then rerun the gate`)
+ for(let page=1;;page++) {
+  const response=await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/mr-exception/salimon/issues/${pr}/comments?per_page=100&page=${page}`,{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,Accept:'application/vnd.github+json'}})
+  if(!response.ok)throw Error(`Cannot read baseline approvals: HTTP ${response.status}`)
+  const batch=await response.json();if(!Array.isArray(batch))throw Error('Invalid approval response')
+  comments.push(...batch);if(batch.length<100)break
+ }
+}
+const approved=inherited||verifyApproval(comments,digest)
+await mkdir('test-results',{recursive:true})
+await writeFile('test-results/baseline-approval.json',JSON.stringify({digest,base,inherited,approved,scope:'Human baseline approval; independent implementation QA remains separate.'},null,2)+'\n')
+if(!approved)throw Error(`BASELINE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: human OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR must post exactly "Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}"; candidates are not approved references`)
+console.log(`Baseline approval PASS (${inherited?'inherited from base':'explicit human review'}): ${digest}`)

+// Test a real CSS defect through the running App and screenshot comparator.
+import {cp,mkdtemp,mkdir,readFile,writeFile,symlink,rm} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {tmpdir} from 'node:os'
+import {join,resolve,basename} from 'node:path'
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto'
+const root=process.cwd(),output=resolve(process.env.SALIMON_VISUAL_NEGATIVE_DIR??'test-results/visual-negative')
+const scratch=await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(),'salimon-visual-negative-'))
+const hash=s=>createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex')
+try {
+ await cp(root,scratch,{recursive:true,filter:path=>!['node_modules','test-results','playwright-report','.git'].includes(basename(path))})
+ await symlink(join(root,'node_modules'),join(scratch,'node_modules'),'dir')
+ // Preserve revision metadata without making the copy a mutable repository.
+ const git=await readFile(join(root,'.revision-for-negative'),'utf8').catch(()=>null)
+ const source=git??spawnSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{cwd:root,encoding:'utf8'}).stdout.trim()
+ await writeFile(join(scratch,'.revision-for-negative'),source)
+ const target=join(scratch,'src/styles.css'),original=await readFile(target,'utf8')
+ const before='[data-vector=velocity]{stroke:#b6f5a2;',after='[data-vector=velocity]{stroke:#ff0000;'
+ if(original.split(before).length!==2)throw Error('Visual mutation must match exactly once')
+ const changed=original.replace(before,after);await writeFile(target,changed)
+ const child=spawnSync(process.execPath,[join(root,'node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js'),'test','--project=navigation-captures'],{cwd:scratch,env:{...process.env,CI:'true',SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES:'',SALIMON_EVIDENCE_DIR:output},encoding:'utf8',timeout:240000,maxBuffer:2e6})
+ await mkdir(output,{recursive:true});await writeFile(join(output,'command.log'),`${child.stdout??''}\n${child.stderr??''}`)
+ const report=JSON.parse(await readFile(join(output,'results.json'),'utf8'))
+ const specs=suite=>[...(suite.specs??[]),...(suite.suites??[]).flatMap(specs)]
+ const results=report.suites.flatMap(specs).flatMap(s=>s.tests??[]).flatMap(t=>t.results??[])
+ const attachments=results[0]?.attachments??[]
+ const summaryAttachment=attachments.find(a=>a.name==='comparison-summary.json')
+ const summary=summaryAttachment?JSON.parse(summaryAttachment.body?Buffer.from(summaryAttachment.body,'base64').toString():await readFile(summaryAttachment.path,'utf8')):null
+ const errors=results.flatMap(r=>r.errors??[]).map(e=>e.message??'').join('\n')
+ const detected=child.status===1&&!child.error&&report.stats.unexpected===1&&results.length===1&&results[0].status==='failed'&&summary?.results.length===8&&summary.results.filter(r=>!r.pass).length===2&&summary.results.filter(r=>!r.pass).every(r=>['heading-velocity','opposite-vectors'].includes(r.id)&&r.changedPixels>100)&&errors.includes('VISUAL_PIXEL_MISMATCH heading-velocity')&&errors.includes('VISUAL_PIXEL_MISMATCH opposite-vectors')
+ await writeFile(join(output,'mutation-summary.json'),JSON.stringify({status:detected?'PASS':'INVALID_DEMONSTRATION',source,file:'src/styles.css',original_sha256:hash(original),mutated_sha256:hash(changed),mutation:{before,after},exit:child.status,comparison:summary},null,2)+'\n')
+ if(!detected)throw Error(`Visual defect did not fail only the intended comparisons: ${output}`)
+ console.log('VIS-1 PASS: red velocity fails two real browser screenshots; six unchanged screens pass; originals/diffs/trace retained')
+} finally {await rm(scratch,{recursive:true,force:true})}

+import {compareImages,verifyApproval} from './visual-comparison.ts'
+

+ const a=new PNG({width:128,height:80});a.data.fill(255)
+ const original=PNG.sync.write(a)
+ assert.equal(compareImages(original,original).changedPixels,0)
+ for(let y=20;y<40;y++)for(let x=30;x<70;x++)a.data.set([255,0,0,255],(y*128+x)*4)

+ assert.equal(PNG.sync.read(result.diff).width,128)

+ assert.throws(()=>compareImages(original,Buffer.from('invalid PNG')))
+})
+test('VIS-3 approval is exact, digest-bound and requires a human collaborator',()=>{

--- /dev/null
+++ b/client/scripts/visual-comparison.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto'
+import {PNG} from 'pngjs'
+import pixelmatch from 'pixelmatch'
+
+// No masks. Reject every pixel beyond the perceptual color threshold, including
+// antialiasing differences. A single changed line cannot hide in a global ratio.
+export const POLICY={threshold:0.1,maxDiffPixels:0,includeAA:true,masks:[]} as const
+export const sha256=(data:Buffer|string)=>createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')
+export function compareImages(expected:Buffer,actual:Buffer) {
+ const a=PNG.sync.read(expected),b=PNG.sync.read(actual)
+ if(a.width!==b.width||a.height!==b.height)throw Error(`VISUAL_DIMENSIONS: ${a.width}x${a.height} vs ${b.width}x${b.height}`)
+ const diff=new PNG({width:a.width,height:a.height})
+ const changedPixels=pixelmatch(a.data,b.data,diff.data,a.width,a.height,{threshold:POLICY.threshold,includeAA:POLICY.includeAA})
+ let rawChangedPixels=0
+ for(let i=0;i<a.data.length;i+=4)if(!a.data.subarray(i,i+4).equals(b.data.subarray(i,i+4)))rawChangedPixels++
+ return {pass:changedPixels<=POLICY.maxDiffPixels,changedPixels,rawChangedPixels,totalPixels:a.width*a.height,diff:PNG.sync.write(diff)}
+}
+export function verifyApproval(comments:{body?:string|null;user?:{type?:string}|null;author_association?:string}[],digest:string) {
+ return comments.some(c=>c.body?.trim()===`Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}`&&c.user?.type==='User'&&['OWNER','MEMBER','COLLABORATOR'].includes(c.author_association??''))
+}

+# Navigation visual references (#751)
+
+These eight initial images are **candidates pending explicit human approval**.
+Pixel equality is separate from accepting a reference as correct. The CI approval
+gate must pass before QA acceptance. No implementation agent may post approval.
+
+| Original | Observable case |
+| --- | --- |
+| [Empty scanner](empty-scanner.png) | Seeded universe before the first scan, no catalog leak |
+| [Visible contacts](visible-contacts.png) | Four distinct faceted bodies, fixed front camera |
+| [Panning](panned-contacts.png) | Real D-key camera movement, bodies retained |
+| [Selected body](selected-body.png) | Moon picker selection and selection geometry |
+| [Zoom out](zoom-out.png) | Fixed zoom 0.1, linear world projection |
+| [Zoom in](zoom-in.png) | Fixed zoom 1, readable proxies |
+| [Heading/velocity](heading-velocity.png) | Yellow heading right, green dashed velocity up |
+| [Opposite vectors](opposite-vectors.png) | Heading and velocity reach opposite edges |
+
+Full 1280×800 viewport images include the actual WebGL canvas, DOM vector overlay
+and sidebar layout. No masks, cropping, dynamic substitutions or CSS geometry
+changes are applied. Vendored, licensed DejaVu fonts supply the fixture's `Inter`
+family to avoid host fallback changes. Ordinary production and browser tests still
+exercise system fonts; this fixture CSS does not ship in the production entry.
+
+## Compare and retain evidence
+
+```sh
+npm ci
+npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+npm run build
+npm run test:visual
+SALIMON_EVIDENCE_DIR=test-results/visual-repeat npm run test:visual
+npm run test:visual:negative
+```
+
+Use the lockfile Chromium on Linux x64; do not set `CHROMIUM_PATH` for reference
+qualification. Environment drift (browser/Playwright/platform/architecture/font
+hashes/renderer) fails explicitly. Host distro/version is recorded in the issue
+report/CI runner rather than asserting Debian and Ubuntu are the same OS.
+Seed 750, fixture front camera, fixed zooms, DPR 1, en-US/UTC, dark scheme and
+paused RAF/performance clock are recorded in `manifest.json` and observations.
+The capture waits for fonts and completed production frames. Screenshot capture
+never fast-forwards animations. Traces are retained even on success.
+
+`comparisons/` under each test output contains actual, expected, diff and original
+state/metadata JSON for every case. The summary records changed and raw changed
+pixels and both hashes. Pixelmatch uses color threshold 0.1, includes antialiasing,
+and permits **zero** pixels over threshold. No mask is justified by these frozen
+scenes. CI uploads SHA-named originals/diffs/metadata/traces for 14 days; essential
+issue evidence is retained beside the delivery report. A page error, environment
+change, absent contacts, wrong selection or corrupted/missing reference fails.
+
+The negative driver changes the actual velocity CSS to red in a disposable copy.
+Only the two velocity-visible frames must fail, with >100 changed pixels each;
+the other six must pass. Timeout, startup error or unrelated visual failures do
+not count as detecting the defect. It never edits checkout references.
+
+## Propose and independently approve a baseline
+
+1. First investigate the unexpected difference. Never update references merely
+   because a check fails. Browser/OS upgrades are separate deliberate changes;
+   retain old and new originals, environment versions, metrics and upgrade reason.
+2. Generate *candidates* outside the tracked reference directory:
+   `SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES=/tmp/navigation-candidates npm run test:visual`.
+   Candidate generation is forbidden in CI. `--update-snapshots` has no effect on
+   this custom comparator and cannot update these files.
+3. Copy reviewed candidates and their complete `manifest.json` into this directory
+   in a dedicated reviewable change. Run normal comparisons twice and the negative
+   driver; preserve the previous originals in git and expected/diff artifacts.
+4. A human repository OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR independently reviews every image,
+   environment/threshold change, functional tests and diff. Post exactly this on
+   the delivering PR, substituting the SHA-256 of the **manifest bytes**:
+   `Approve navigation baselines: <sha256>`.
+   Agents must never write this comment, impersonate the reviewer or count their
+   own image judgment as approval. The human can use the same GitHub account that
+   hosts an agent-authored PR; independence is from the implementing agent.
+5. Rerun the failed approval step/job. It validates image hashes and accepts only
+   that exact digest from a human collaborator (Bot/unaffiliated accounts fail).
+   Any changed manifest invalidates the approval. A byte-identical manifest
+   inherited from the PR base needs no repeat approval. Baseline approval does
+   not replace independent implementation QA or authorize merging.
+
+GitHub branch protection must require the Navigation client check for enforcement
+at merge; this issue does not change repository administration settings. A repo
+maintainer can always alter workflow policy; ordinary implementation agents cannot
+waive it. Review comments are audit evidence, not a cryptographic proof of who
+operated an account. Required human decisions stay visible as BLOCKED until made.
+
+Software SwiftShader browser coverage does not qualify physical input, discrete
+GPUs, Metal, Windows rendering, native platforms, hardware FPS or subjective art.
+Historical native mesh regression #228 is a distinct renderer/asset contract.

+import {test,expect} from '@playwright/test'
+import {readFile,writeFile,mkdir} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {join} from 'node:path'
+import {boot,snapshot,json,EPOCH} from './deterministic'
+import {POLICY,sha256,compareImages} from '../scripts/visual-comparison.ts'
+
+const directory='tests/navigation-baselines'
+const candidate=process.env.SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES||undefined
+if(candidate&&process.env.CI)throw Error('Candidate generation is forbidden in CI')
+const cases=[
+ {id:'empty-scanner',scenario:'seeded-empty',vector:'zero'},
+ {id:'visible-contacts'},
+ {id:'panned-contacts',pan:true},
+ {id:'selected-body',selected:true},
+ {id:'zoom-out',zoom:.1},
+ {id:'zoom-in',zoom:1},
+ {id:'heading-velocity',vector:'different'},
+ {id:'opposite-vectors',vector:'opposite'}
+] as const
+// One ordered session preserves a single manifest and complete comparison summary.
+test('VIS-1/2 eight navigation screens match reference pixels',async({page,browser},info)=>{
+ const errors:string[]=[];page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message))
+ const fonts=await Promise.all(['DejaVuSans.ttf','DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf','fonts.css'].map(async f=>[f,sha256(await readFile(`tests/assets/${f}`))]))
+ const source=(await readFile('.revision-for-negative','utf8').catch(()=>null))??execFileSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{encoding:'utf8'}).trim()
+ const environment={platform:process.platform,arch:process.arch,browser:browser.version(),playwright:JSON.parse(await readFile('node_modules/@playwright/test/package.json','utf8')).version,viewport:{width:1280,height:800},dpr:1,locale:'en-US',timezone:'UTC',colorScheme:'dark',fontHashes:Object.fromEntries(fonts),seed:750,epoch:EPOCH,policy:POLICY}
+ const manifest=candidate?null:JSON.parse(await readFile(`${directory}/manifest.json`,'utf8'))
+ const results:Record<string,unknown>[]=[],images:Record<string,string>={}
+ const output=candidate??info.outputPath('comparisons')
+ await mkdir(output,{recursive:true})
+ // Drift is a failure, never an instruction to regenerate references.
+ if(manifest)expect(environment,'VISUAL_ENVIRONMENT_DRIFT: propose separately reviewed candidates').toEqual(manifest.environment)
+ for(const fixture of cases) {
+  const c:{id:string;scenario?:string;vector?:string;pan?:boolean;selected?:boolean;zoom?:number}=fixture
+  await boot(page,`scenario=${c.scenario??'seeded'}&seed=750&view=front&vector=${c.vector??'zero'}&zoom=${c.zoom??.5}`)
+  await page.evaluate(()=>document.fonts.ready)
+  if(c.selected)await page.getByLabel('Scanned contacts (4)',{exact:true}).selectOption('moon')
+  if(c.pan){await page.keyboard.down('d');await page.clock.runFor(160);await page.keyboard.up('d')}
+  // Deterministic completed RAF; no screenshot animation fast-forward or polling
+  // against mutating frames. Font loading completes before this last frame.
+  await page.clock.runFor(32)
+  await page.mouse.move(1279,799)
+  const state=await snapshot(page)
+  expect(state.scene.renderer,'VISUAL_BACKEND').toContain('SwiftShader')
+  if(manifest)expect(state.scene.renderer,'VISUAL_RENDERER_DRIFT').toBe(manifest.renderer)
+  if(c.scenario==='seeded-empty')expect(state.navigation.pulse).toBe(0)
+  else expect(state.scene.objects.filter(o=>o.name.startsWith('nav-body:')).length,'VISUAL_NONVACUOUS_CONTACTS').toBeGreaterThan(0)
+  if(c.selected)expect(state.navigation.selected).toBe('moon')
+  const actual=await page.screenshot({caret:'hide'})
+  const name=`${c.id}.png`;images[name]=sha256(actual)
+  await writeFile(join(output,name),actual)
+  await writeFile(join(output,`${c.id}.json`),json({source,environment,fixture,state,errors}))
+  await info.attach(name,{body:actual,contentType:'image/png'})
+  if(candidate){results.push({id:c.id,status:'CANDIDATE',sha256:sha256(actual)});continue}
+  const original=await readFile(join(directory,name))
+  expect(sha256(original),'BASELINE_HASH_MISMATCH').toBe(manifest.images[name])
+  const comparison=compareImages(original,actual)
+  await writeFile(join(output,`${c.id}-expected.png`),original)
+  await writeFile(join(output,`${c.id}-diff.png`),comparison.diff)
+  await info.attach(`${c.id}-diff.png`,{body:comparison.diff,contentType:'image/png'})
+  const {diff:_,...measurement}=comparison
+  results.push({id:c.id,...measurement,expected:sha256(original),actual:sha256(actual)})
+ }
+ expect(errors,'VISUAL_PAGE_ERRORS').toEqual([])
+ if(candidate) {
+  const renderer=(await snapshot(page)).scene.renderer
+  await writeFile(join(output,'manifest.json'),json({schema:1,environment,renderer,images})+'\n')
+ }
+ await writeFile(join(output,'summary.json'),json({source,candidate:!!candidate,results})+'\n')
+ await info.attach('comparison-summary.json',{body:json({source,candidate:!!candidate,results}),contentType:'application/json'})
+ // Soft per-frame failures let QA inspect every unexpected screen in one run.
+ for(const r of results)if(!candidate)expect.soft(r.pass,`VISUAL_PIXEL_MISMATCH ${r.id}: ${r.changedPixels} changed pixels`).toBe(true)
+})

 Browser automation uses synthetic input and software WebGL; it does not certify
 physical input, native platforms or hardware FPS.
+
+## Navigation screenshot regression (#751)
+
+The [visual reference guide](tests/navigation-baselines/README.md) owns the eight
+frozen browser screens, fixed fonts/browser/backend, pixel comparison policy,
+intentional visual defect demonstration and explicit independent baseline approval.
+`npm run test:visual` compares all screens; run it twice for determinism and run
+`npm run test:visual:negative` to prove the comparator rejects a real CSS defect.
+The ordinary `test:browser` suite includes these captures. Candidate generation
+never approves a baseline; CI blocks changed references until a human collaborator
+approves the exact manifest digest. Software WebGL does not qualify hardware GPUs.

+++ b/client/scripts/baseline-approval.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+// Read-only gate. Agents must never post the human approval this checks for.
+import {readFile,mkdir,writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {sha256,verifyApproval} from './visual-comparison.ts'
+
+const path='tests/navigation-baselines/manifest.json'
+const manifestBytes=await readFile(path),manifest=JSON.parse(manifestBytes.toString()),digest=sha256(manifestBytes)
+for(const [name,expected] of Object.entries(manifest.images)) {
+ if(!/^[a-z-]+\.png$/.test(name))throw Error('Invalid baseline path')
+ if(sha256(await readFile(`tests/navigation-baselines/${name}`))!==expected)throw Error(`Baseline hash mismatch: ${name}`)
+}
+const base=process.env.SALIMON_BASE_SHA
+if(!base||!/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(base))throw Error('Expected SALIMON_BASE_SHA (exact PR base)')
+let inherited=false
+try {inherited=execFileSync('git',['show',`${base}:client/${path}`],{stdio:['ignore','pipe','ignore']}).equals(manifestBytes)}catch{/* Initial baseline needs approval. */}
+const comments:Parameters<typeof verifyApproval>[0]=[]
+if(!inherited) {
+ const pr=process.env.SALIMON_PR_NUMBER,token=process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
+ if(!pr||!/^\d+$/.test(pr)||!token)throw Error(`BASELINE_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: post human review "Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}" to this PR, then rerun the gate`)
+ for(let page=1;;page++) {
+  const response=await fetch(`https://api.github.com/repos/mr-exception/salimon/issues/${pr}/comments?per_page=100&page=${page}`,{headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`,Accept:'application/vnd.github+json'}})
+  if(!response.ok)throw Error(`Cannot read baseline approvals: HTTP ${response.status}`)

+// Test a real CSS defect through the running App and screenshot comparator.
+import {cp,mkdtemp,mkdir,readFile,writeFile,symlink,rm} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {tmpdir} from 'node:os'
+import {join,resolve,basename} from 'node:path'
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto'
+const root=process.cwd(),output=resolve(process.env.SALIMON_VISUAL_NEGATIVE_DIR??'test-results/visual-negative')
+const scratch=await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(),'salimon-visual-negative-'))
+const hash=s=>createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex')
+try {
+ await cp(root,scratch,{recursive:true,filter:path=>!['node_modules','test-results','playwright-report','.git'].includes(basename(path))})
+ await symlink(join(root,'node_modules'),join(scratch,'node_modules'),'dir')
+ // Preserve revision metadata without making the copy a mutable repository.
+ const git=await readFile(join(root,'.revision-for-negative'),'utf8').catch(()=>null)
+ const source=git??spawnSync('git',['rev-parse','HEAD'],{cwd:root,encoding:'utf8'}).stdout.trim()
+ await writeFile(join(scratch,'.revision-for-negative'),source)
+ const target=join(scratch,'src/styles.css'),original=await readFile(target,'utf8')
+ const before='[data-vector=velocity]{stroke:#b6f5a2;',after='[data-vector=velocity]{stroke:#ff0000;'
+ if(original.split(before).length!==2)throw Error('Visual mutation must match exactly once')
+ const changed=original.replace(before,after);await writeFile(target,changed)
+ const child=spawnSync(process.execPath,[join(root,'node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js'),'test','--project=navigation-captures'],{cwd:scratch,env:{...process.env,CI:'true',SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES:'',SALIMON_EVIDENCE_DIR:output},encoding:'utf8',timeout:240000,maxBuffer:2e6})
+ await mkdir(output,{recursive:true});await writeFile(join(output,'command.log'),`${child.stdout??''}\n${child.stderr??''}`)
+ const report=JSON.parse(await readFile(join(output,'results.json'),'utf8'))
+ const specs=suite=>[...(suite.specs??[]),...(suite.suites??[]).flatMap(specs)]
+ const results=report.suites.flatMap(specs).flatMap(s=>s.tests??[]).flatMap(t=>t.results??[])
+ const attachments=results[0]?.attachments??[]
+ const summaryAttachment=attachments.find(a=>a.name==='comparison-summary.json')
+ const summary=summaryAttachment?JSON.parse(summaryAttachment.body?Buffer.from(summaryAttachment.body,'base64').toString():await readFile(summaryAttachment.path,'utf8')):null
+ const errors=results.flatMap(r=>r.errors??[]).map(e=>e.message??'').join('\n')
+ const detected=child.status===1&&!child.error&&report.stats.unexpected===1&&results.length===1&&results[0].status==='failed'&&summary?.results.length===8&&summary.results.filter(r=>!r.pass).length===2&&summary.results.filter(r=>!r.pass).every(r=>['heading-velocity','opposite-vectors'].includes(r.id)&&r.changedPixels>100)&&errors.includes('VISUAL_PIXEL_MISMATCH heading-velocity')&&errors.includes('VISUAL_PIXEL_MISMATCH opposite-vectors')
+ await writeFile(join(output,'mutation-summary.json'),JSON.stringify({status:detected?'PASS':'INVALID_DEMONSTRATION',source,file:'src/styles.css',original_sha256:hash(original),mutated_sha256:hash(changed),mutation:{before,after},exit:child.status,comparison:summary},null,2)+'\n')
+ if(!detected)throw Error(`Visual defect did not fail only the intended comparisons: ${output}`)
+ console.log('VIS-1 PASS: red velocity fails two real browser screenshots; six unchanged screens pass; originals/diffs/trace retained')
+} finally {await rm(scratch,{recursive:true,force:true})}

+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto'
+import {PNG} from 'pngjs'
+import pixelmatch from 'pixelmatch'
+
+// No masks. Reject every pixel beyond the perceptual color threshold, including
+// antialiasing differences. A single changed line cannot hide in a global ratio.
+export const POLICY={threshold:0.1,maxDiffPixels:0,includeAA:true,masks:[]} as const
+export const sha256=(data:Buffer|string)=>createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')
+export function compareImages(expected:Buffer,actual:Buffer) {
+ const a=PNG.sync.read(expected),b=PNG.sync.read(actual)
+ if(a.width!==b.width||a.height!==b.height)throw Error(`VISUAL_DIMENSIONS: ${a.width}x${a.height} vs ${b.width}x${b.height}`)
+ const diff=new PNG({width:a.width,height:a.height})
+ const changedPixels=pixelmatch(a.data,b.data,diff.data,a.width,a.height,{threshold:POLICY.threshold,includeAA:POLICY.includeAA})
+ let rawChangedPixels=0
+ for(let i=0;i<a.data.length;i+=4)if(!a.data.subarray(i,i+4).equals(b.data.subarray(i,i+4)))rawChangedPixels++
+ return {pass:changedPixels<=POLICY.maxDiffPixels,changedPixels,rawChangedPixels,totalPixels:a.width*a.height,diff:PNG.sync.write(diff)}
+}
+export function verifyApproval(comments:{body?:string|null;user?:{type?:string}|null;author_association?:string}[],digest:string) {
+ return comments.some(c=>c.body?.trim()===`Approve navigation baselines: ${digest}`&&c.user?.type==='User'&&['OWNER','MEMBER','COLLABORATOR'].includes(c.author_association??''))
+}

+# Navigation visual references (#751)
+
+These eight initial images are **candidates pending explicit human approval**.
+Pixel equality is separate from accepting a reference as correct. The CI approval
+gate must pass before QA acceptance. No implementation agent may post approval.
+
+| Original | Observable case |
+| --- | --- |
+| [Empty scanner](empty-scanner.png) | Seeded universe before the first scan, no catalog leak |
+| [Visible contacts](visible-contacts.png) | Four distinct faceted bodies, fixed front camera |
+| [Panning](panned-contacts.png) | Real D-key camera movement, bodies retained |
+| [Selected body](selected-body.png) | Moon picker selection and selection geometry |
+| [Zoom out](zoom-out.png) | Fixed zoom 0.1, linear world projection |
+| [Zoom in](zoom-in.png) | Fixed zoom 1, readable proxies |
+| [Heading/velocity](heading-velocity.png) | Yellow heading right, green dashed velocity up |
+| [Opposite vectors](opposite-vectors.png) | Heading and velocity reach opposite edges |
+
+Full 1280×800 viewport images include the actual WebGL canvas, DOM vector overlay
+and sidebar layout. No masks, cropping, dynamic substitutions or CSS geometry
+changes are applied. Vendored, licensed DejaVu fonts supply the fixture's `Inter`
+family to avoid host fallback changes. Ordinary production and browser tests still
+exercise system fonts; this fixture CSS does not ship in the production entry.
+
+## Compare and retain evidence
+
+```sh
+npm ci
+npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+npm run build
+npm run test:visual
+SALIMON_EVIDENCE_DIR=test-results/visual-repeat npm run test:visual
+npm run test:visual:negative
+```
+
+Use the lockfile Chromium on Linux x64; do not set `CHROMIUM_PATH` for reference
+qualification. Environment drift (browser/Playwright/platform/architecture/font
+hashes/renderer) fails explicitly. Host distro/version is recorded in the issue
+report/CI runner rather than asserting Debian and Ubuntu are the same OS.
+Seed 750, fixture front camera, fixed zooms, DPR 1, en-US/UTC, dark scheme and
+paused RAF/performance clock are recorded in `manifest.json` and observations.
+The capture waits for fonts and completed production frames. Screenshot capture
+never fast-forwards animations. Traces are retained even on success.
+
+`comparisons/` under each test output contains actual, expected, diff and original
+state/metadata JSON for every case. The summary records changed and raw changed
+pixels and both hashes. Pixelmatch uses color threshold 0.1, includes antialiasing,
+and permits **zero** pixels over threshold. No mask is justified by these frozen
+scenes. CI uploads SHA-named originals/diffs/metadata/traces for 14 days; essential
+issue evidence is retained beside the delivery report. A page error, environment
+change, absent contacts, wrong selection or corrupted/missing reference fails.
+
+The negative driver changes the actual velocity CSS to red in a disposable copy.
+Only the two velocity-visible frames must fail, with >100 changed pixels each;
+the other six must pass. Timeout, startup error or unrelated visual failures do
+not count as detecting the defect. It never edits checkout references.
+
+## Propose and independently approve a baseline
+
+1. First investigate the unexpected difference. Never update references merely
+   because a check fails. Browser/OS upgrades are separate deliberate changes;
+   retain old and new originals, environment versions, metrics and upgrade reason.
+2. Generate *candidates* outside the tracked reference directory:
+   `SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES=/tmp/navigation-candidates npm run test:visual`.
+   Candidate generation is forbidden in CI. `--update-snapshots` has no effect on
+   this custom comparator and cannot update these files.
+3. Copy reviewed candidates and their complete `manifest.json` into this directory
+   in a dedicated reviewable change. Run normal comparisons twice and the negative
+   driver; preserve the previous originals in git and expected/diff artifacts.
+4. A human repository OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR independently reviews every image,
+   environment/threshold change, functional tests and diff. Post exactly this on
+   the delivering PR, substituting the SHA-256 of the **manifest bytes**:
+   `Approve navigation baselines: <sha256>`.
+   Agents must never write this comment, impersonate the reviewer or count their
+   own image judgment as approval. The human can use the same GitHub account that
+   hosts an agent-authored PR; independence is from the implementing agent.
+5. Rerun the failed approval step/job. It validates image hashes and accepts only
+   that exact digest from a human collaborator (Bot/unaffiliated accounts fail).
+   Any changed manifest invalidates the approval. A byte-identical manifest
+   inherited from the PR base needs no repeat approval. Baseline approval does
+   not replace independent implementation QA or authorize merging.
+
+GitHub branch protection must require the Navigation client check for enforcement
+at merge; this issue does not change repository administration settings. A repo
+maintainer can always alter workflow policy; ordinary implementation agents cannot
+waive it. Review comments are audit evidence, not a cryptographic proof of who
+operated an account. Required human decisions stay visible as BLOCKED until made.
+
+Software SwiftShader browser coverage does not qualify physical input, discrete
+GPUs, Metal, Windows rendering, native platforms, hardware FPS or subjective art.
+Historical native mesh regression #228 is a distinct renderer/asset contract.

+import {test,expect} from '@playwright/test'
+import {readFile,writeFile,mkdir} from 'node:fs/promises'
+import {execFileSync} from 'node:child_process'
+import {join} from 'node:path'
+import {boot,snapshot,json,EPOCH} from './deterministic'
+import {POLICY,sha256,compareImages} from '../scripts/visual-comparison.ts'
+
+const directory='tests/navigation-baselines'
+const candidate=process.env.SALIMON_CAPTURE_CANDIDATES||undefined
+if(candidate&&process.env.CI)throw Error('Candidate generation is forbidden in CI')
+const cases=[
+ {id:'empty-scanner',scenario:'seeded-empty',vector:'zero'},
+ {id:'visible-contacts'},
+ {id:'panned-contacts',pan:true},
+ {id:'selected-body',selected:true},
+ {id:'zoom-out',zoom:.1},
+ {id:'zoom-in',zoom:1},
+ {id:'heading-velocity',vector:'different'},
+ {id:'opposite-vectors',vector:'opposite'}
